title: Immune collapse and treatment at Brooke General Hospital
place_text: Brooke General Hospital, San Antonio, Texas

tellings.quote: I end up at Brook General Hospital.

plain: In 1952, the writer Whitley Strieber says, his immune system collapsed and he ended up being treated at Brooke General Hospital in San Antonio, Texas. Strieber, who says on the show that he has met aliens, tells this from his own life and points to a school report card from the time. He brings it up as part of the strange events of his early life.
